purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-nextjs-test-lint-setup (renamed from ugt-nextjs-quality-setup in v3.0.0). S* queries must route here; N* must NOT (writing tests = normal dev work, pipeline/server config → cicd-setup, code violations → clean-code).
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors
